name: Aarav Sharma
tagline: I build systems that connect hardware, data, and AI.

about.short: Fresher developer with a strong foundation in Python, React, and embedded systems. I love building products that bridge the physical and digital worlds.
about.long: I'm an Electronics and Communication Engineering graduate who fell in love with software. Over the past two years I've built full-stack apps, IoT prototypes, and AI tools. I'm comfortable from PCB to PostgreSQL, from Arduino to AWS. Currently exploring VLSI design and edge AI.

philosophy.title: The Clean Layer Obsession
philosophy.description: Designing backend structures and API interfaces that are intuitive, scalable, and ruthlessly efficient.

philosophy.title: Aggressive Automation
philosophy.description: If a task has to be done manually more than twice, it deserves a script. I build automation layers to handle the mundane, freeing mental bandwidth for complex architecture.

philosophy.title: The Translation Engine
philosophy.description: High-level engineering is useless if it lives in an ivory tower. I distill dense, abstract technical concepts into plain, transparent ideas that anyone can immediately execute on.

background.intro: When the IDE is closed, my brain doesn't stop optimizing. The same mindset that drives my code runs my personal world.

sections.title: Strategic Sandboxes & Tacticals
sections.content: I view gaming through an engineering lens. Whether I am architecting complex automated systems in Minecraft survival or executing tight, calculated rotations with a team in BGMI, it's all optimization and risk management under a different skin.

sections.title: Structural Storytelling
sections.content: I have a deep appreciation for the high-stakes narrative scales and razor-sharp character designs found in modern manga and anime. Analyzing the tactical depth of Jujutsu Kaisen or the absolute scale of One-Punch Man satisfies my love for brilliant, creative world-building.
